objective: Reuse a verified immutable reviewed candidate when Firestore map ordering changes JSON serialization, preserving the existing bytes and generation.
acceptance_criteria: Existing reviewed artifact is read at its metadata generation and verified by bounded size and SHA256.
Whole JSON content must match canonically, including report, all source/review identities, candidate hash and parse reasons; any divergence rejects without overwrite.
Synthetic import/recovery with reordered Firestore maps preserves exact bytes, generation and idempotency; tampering remains rejected.
GitHub CI only; no local product execution or provider calls.
validation_commands: GitHub Actions Google v0 integration: node --test tests/*.test.mjs
GitHub Actions Google v0 integration: image build and isolated smoke checks

review.reason: Independent review and exact-head GitHub CI required before integration.
